title: Reactor fills a set buffer under bounded demand
summary: The duplicate made the parent time out with no emitted set. The fix completed with {1,2} on one request. Two requests returned two distinct sets and the discard hook saw the duplicate 1 exactly once.

change.description: The report describes a stall with bounded demand. The merge should emit exactly {1,2} and complete without another downstream request.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.
Both deployments use the same pin-built reactor-test subscriber. The reactor-core JAR changes with the revision.
